properties.displayName: Parameterized Network Session ASIM parser for Gigamon V-Series Application Metadata Intelligence
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dstipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dstportnumber:int=int(null),
    hostname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dvcaction:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string='*',
    pack:bool=false,
    disabled:bool=false
) {
    GigamonV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(start_time), TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(end_time), todatetime(start_time), TimeGenerated),
        NetworkProtocol = case(
            isempty(protocol), "",
            protocol in~ ("6", "TCP"), "TCP",
            protocol in~ ("17", "UDP"), "UDP",
            protocol
        ),
        SrcIpAddr = coalesce(src_ip, src_ipv6),
        DstIpAddr = coalesce(dst_ip, dst_ipv6)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or EventStartTime >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or EventEndTime <= endtime)
        and (array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or SrcIpAddr has_any (srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
        and (array_length(dstipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or DstIpAddr has_any (dstipaddr_has_any_prefix))
        and (array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or SrcIpAddr has_any (ipaddr_has_any_prefix) or DstIpAddr has_any (ipaddr_has_any_prefix))
        and (array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0)
        and (array_length(dvcaction) == 0)
        and (isnull(dstportnumber) or toint(dst_port) == dstportnumber)
        and (eventresult == '*' or eventresult == 'Success')
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventProduct = "V-Series Application Metadata Intelligence",
        EventVendor = "Gigamon",
        EventSchema = "NetworkSession",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.2.7",
        EventType = "NetworkSession",
        EventResult = "Success",
        Dvc = coalesce(generator, vendor),
        SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        DstIpAddr,
        Src = coalesce(src_ip, src_ipv6, src_mac),
        Dst = coalesce(dst_ip, dst_ipv6, dst_mac),
        SrcPortNumber = toint(src_port),
        DstPortNumber = toint(dst_port),
        NetworkProtocol,
        SrcBytes = tolong(src_bytes),
        DstBytes = tolong(dst_bytes),
        SrcPackets = tolong(src_packets),
        DstPackets = tolong(dst_packets),
        EventUid = id,
        Type = "GigamonV2_CL"
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    dstipaddr_has_any_prefix=dstipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    dstportnumber=dstportnumber,
    hostname_has_any=hostname_has_any,
    dvcaction=dvcaction,
    eventresult=eventresult,
    pack=pack,
    disabled=disabled
)
